prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original RTS faction concept art, Helix Systems, for subsequent Blender modeling.
Primary request: establish a near-future precision robotics military faction in a stylized modern combat RTS. Exaggerated but physically engineered military machines. A coherent deployed force at an alpine communications facility.
Subject: foreground slender armored human operator with enclosed visor and rifle, low six-wheeled engineering rover, sleek low-profile split-hull hover tank with central precision cannon, four-legged angular combat robot, triangular three-duct scout drone, and swept-wing twin-engine unmanned strike aircraft above. Background modular command facility and open drone launch gantries. Clear readable unit silhouettes.
Style/medium: polished stylized 3D game concept painting, bold primary shapes with restrained mechanical detail, suitable for simplification into actual low-poly RTS models. Not photorealistic. Three-quarter aerial camera low enough to read hardware.
Color palette: warm ivory ceramic armor over graphite mechanisms, deep teal faction panels, turquoise optics, small orange warning marks. No camouflage. Cool alpine rock, concrete and conifers.
Materials: matte ceramic panels, dark brushed metal, rubber wheels, restrained emissive optics. Split noses, paired swept fins, negative spaces, open gantries. Avoid bulky tracked heavy-armor shapes.
Lighting: clear cool daylight with warm rim light; visually separated machinery.
Text: no text, no watermarks, no existing franchise symbols. Landscape composition.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 3D modeling reference sheet for HELIX SYSTEMS, eight military RTS units.
Primary request: eight fully visible, separated unit designs, two rows of four, clean pale cool-gray studio background, orthographic-like front three-quarter views, generous gutters. Clear modest sans-serif labels exactly as below, one per unit. Stylized hard-surface 3D game art, chunky readable shapes, low-to-medium geometric complexity.
Shared design: ivory ceramic armor shells, graphite joints and chassis, deep teal identification panels, thin turquoise optics and restrained orange warning marks. Forked noses, split hulls, swept wings and open negative spaces. Futuristic modern military engineering, not aliens or fantasy.
Top row: "VECTOR OPERATOR" slender human soldier in segmented armor with closed visor and compact rifle; "MULE ENGINEER" low six-wheel rover with a rear cargo tray and two articulated front tool arms; "NEEDLE SKIMMER" low twin-pontoon hover tank, four visible lift housings beneath pods, central rotating turret and single long slender cannon; "LANCER WALKER" four splayed articulated legs, raised faceted torso, narrow precision gun.
Bottom row: "MENDER ROBOT" squat four-legged maintenance robot with two small repair manipulators and teal service chevrons; "KITE SCOUT" triangular unarmed drone with exactly three large visible circular ducted fans; "WRAITH STRIKER" swept flying-wing unmanned strike aircraft with twin engines, twin tail fins and modest underslung missile pods; "PRISM ARTILLERY" six-wheel long-range vehicle carrying a visibly forked twin-rail accelerator on an elevating turret and stabilizer legs.
Do not add other units. No explosion, battle effects, ornate background, holographic UI, or existing franchise branding. Landscape sheet. Shapes must be plausible for Blender construction.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 3D modeling reference sheet for HELIX SYSTEMS buildings in a stylized military RTS.
Primary request: nine separated structures in a clean 3 by 3 grid, pale gray studio background, front three-quarter isometric views, each fully visible with ground pads, modest legible sans-serif labels exactly as below.
Shared design: ivory ceramic cladding, graphite lower structure, deep teal faction panels, narrow turquoise lights, open angular gantries, paired swept fins and split-roof architecture. Distinct small-screen silhouettes. Modular military infrastructure, not sleek skyscrapers or alien organic architecture. Mechanical detail kept restrained for Blender low-poly models.
Row 1: "NEXUS HQ" tiered hexagonal command hub with two tall swept communications fins; "OPERATOR HUB" two separated low barrack wings connected by a bridge over a central entrance; "ROBOTICS FOUNDRY" two tall sloping side towers framing an open fabrication bay, visible overhead robot arms.
Row 2: "FLIGHT DECK" broad hexagonal landing pad with two rear service pylons and a short control tower; "FLUX GENERATOR" three vertically mounted cylindrical power cores held in a triangular frame; "SIGNAL LAB" a faceted central server block supporting a large open tilted sensor ring between two forked supports.
Row 3: "SERVICE CRADLE" drive-through maintenance pad flanked by two articulated repair arms; "LANCE SENTRY" compact elevated rotating precision-gun turret on three spread supports; "SKYWARD ARRAY" paired angled missile boxes beside a compact radar panel, on a low hexagonal pedestal.
No extra structures, no infantry, no explosions, no detailed environment, no existing franchise symbols. Landscape composition.
